'''Orphne's Fountain''' was an ancient and mysterious device located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]]. Based on [[The Force/Legends|Force-inspired]] technology, the Fountain was a massive jet of water which could erupt from the [[Aleen Underworld|Underworld]] and transport anyone caught in the stream up to the surface world. Water from the stream was collected by an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] working for the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] for nefarious purposes. This [[Dram of Orphne|dram]] was retrieved by the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] before the agent could take it offworld, worshiping it as they worshiped the strange being, [[Orphne/Legends|Orphne]].<ref name="NoP" />
